meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你创建、读取和保存单细胞数据文件(如 .h5ad、zarr),还能对数据进行筛选、拼接、转置等操作,并管理其中的注释信息。
howto.when: 当你提到 .h5ad 或 zarr 文件、需要读写单细胞数据、或要合并多个数据集等场合时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 data.h5ad 文件,并展示 obs 和 var 信息
say.note: Claude 会用 anndata 读取并概要显示

say.text: 把 batch1 和 batch2 两个 h5ad 文件按细胞拼接起来
say.note: 用 ad.concat 合并,并添加批次标签

say.text: 用 backed 模式打开这个大文件,先筛选质量分数高的细胞
say.note: 避免内存不足,再加载过滤子集

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, and write AnnData objects (e.g., .h5ad, zarr), subset or concatenate datasets, and manage observation/variable annotations for single-cell genomics data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with .h5ad/zarr files, reading or writing single-cell data, or concatenating multiple datasets within the scverse ecosystem.

say_en.text: Read this data.h5ad file and show me the obs and var info
say_en.note: Claude reads it with anndata and summarizes

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1 and batch2 h5ad files along cells
Open this large file in backed mode, then filter high-quality cells
say_en.note: Avoids memory issues, loads only the subset
